notes: Complete, verbatim copy of the KoboToolbox KPI (/api/v2) OpenAPI schema served at the source URL. Whole published API; no subsetting or renaming. The asset serializer's annotations are hand-written in KPI and lag the code, which conformance runs against real asset payloads surface as false positives: `settings.country` is typed as an array of strings but is an array of {label, value} objects (kpi/models/asset.py derives `country_codes` as [c['value'] for c in settings['country']]); `permissions` is typed as an array of strings but is an array of permission assignments (AssetPermissionAssignmentReadSerializer); `access_types` is a non-nullable array though get_access_types() returns None; and `summary.languages`, `summary.default_translation` and `deployed_versions.next`/`previous` are typed non-nullable though an untranslated form and an unpaginated list really do return null.
